goal: Prove that the mandatory Miben kér segítséget? service/topic choice is genuinely enforced for page264-origin Form33 submissions, while preserving shared Form33, ID5, ID6 and all other pages.

why_open.d05: The source radio-group JavaScript does not prove group-level checked validation; the target must genuinely enforce the mandatory topic choice.
why_open.existing_page264_evidence: ID33 proves accessible group labelling and six option semantics, but AX semantics are not submission-time validation proof.
why_open.shared_form_report: metform33-source-parity-v001 proves the photo upload required state and ID5 photo-count validation, but does not record the service-radio required property or a group-level validation result.

ownership_preference: First prefer an already-correct native MetForm field setting/validation path and make no change if it truly rejects an empty required radio group.

If native configuration is marked required but live source code/runtime evidence proves it does not enforce the group, use the existing page264 semantic owner ID33 rather than creating a second page264 snippet by default.
Never mutate shared Form33 settings merely to solve a page264-only behavior if that would alter other pages using Form33.
mandatory_live_reads_before_any_code: Current page264 accepted Elementor hash/JSON validity.
Current Code Snippets ID33 body, active state, scope, code_error and hash; require page264 semantic behavior reconciliation before modification.
Current #af-form-service exact MetForm widget ID/type and settings, including exact mf_input_name, mf_input_required, six option values/order and any native validation/error-text settings.
Current ID5 exact body, hook registration/priority, active state, code_error and route guard so a future service validator cannot overwrite photo-count failures.
Current ID6 active/state only to prove no unrelated form-runtime mutation is needed.

decision_tree.native_required_and_enforced: PASS with read-only evidence; change nothing.
decision_tree.native_required_false_but_page264_can_be: Prefer the narrowest supported page264-local owner/control; prove no shared Form33 mutation before write.
decision_tree.native_required_true_but_group_not_enfor: Prepare an ID33 extension only after exact live field/route/error-copy reads; do not create a second validator snippet by default.
decision_tree.field_or_owner_drift: STOP and reconcile; never guess mf_input_name, options, error message or hook priority.

future_id33_server_filter_contract_if_ne.location: Top-level named callback/filter in the existing ID33 snippet, separate from its wp_footer callback. Keep the existing is_page(264) footer guard unchanged.
future_id33_server_filter_contract_if_ne.route_guard: Exact/current Form33 entries insert route using the convention proven by ID5.
future_id33_server_filter_contract_if_ne.page_guard: Resolve wp_get_referer() with url_to_postid() and require integer page ID 264; do not rely on is_page() inside REST validation.
future_id33_server_filter_contract_if_ne.field_guard: Use only the exact live-read service radio mf_input_name.
future_id33_server_filter_contract_if_ne.preexisting_failure: If incoming validation is already false, return the whole result unchanged so ID5/photo or native errors are never overwritten.
future_id33_server_filter_contract_if_ne.missing_or_empty_service: Return invalid with only the currently proven/native/source-equivalent user-visible error copy.
future_id33_server_filter_contract_if_ne.present_service: Return unchanged. Do not whitelist guessed option values; if value validation is required, use only the six exact current live values.

non_delivery_acceptance_if_filter_needed.method: Invoke the named validation callback directly in a controlled server context with Form33 route/page264 referer and empty exact service field; do not call MetForm Action::submit.
Same synthetic route/page264 context with one current exact option value.
non_delivery_acceptance_if_filter_needed.expected: Incoming valid result remains valid and unrelated form_data remains unchanged.

non_delivery_acceptance_if_filter_needed.method: Same Form33 route with a referer resolving to another page.
non_delivery_acceptance_if_filter_needed.expected: Result remains unchanged; no page264 validator leakage.

non_delivery_acceptance_if_filter_needed.method: Page264 referer but non-Form33 insert route.
Incoming result already invalid with an existing message such as ID5 photo validation.

forbidden_acceptance_shortcuts: No webhook, Slack, Zapier or other delivery.
No second global validator snippet by default.
No change to shared Form33 merely because page264 proof is missing.
postwrite_readback_if_future_fix_is_need: ID33 active=true, code_error=null and new exact hash recorded.
Existing semantic/runtime body preserved plus exactly one named service validator/filter registration.
Direct non-delivery callback cases all pass.
Fresh page264 AX semantics remain unchanged.
